mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_trade_order_log (symbol, side, reason, dry_run, requested_qty, requested_price, toss_order_id, success, message, commission, tax, entry_price, peak_price, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{side}, #{reason}, #{dryRun}, #{requestedQty}, #{requestedPrice}, #{tossOrderId}, #{success}, #{message}, #{commission}, #{tax}, #{entryPrice}, #{peakPrice}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, side, reason, dry_run, requested_qty, requested_price, toss_order_id, success, message, commission, tax, entry_price, peak_price, created_at FROM auto_trade_order_log ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT id, symbol, side, reason, dry_run, requested_qty, requested_price, toss_order_id, success, message, commission, tax, entry_price, peak_price, created_at FROM auto_trade_order_log WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND side = 'BUY' AND success = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
